'''Buzz''' was a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Buzz served in the [[Second Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Second Battle of Geonosis]] under the command of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]], during which he and the general searched for the escaped [[Archduke/Legends|Archduke]] [[Poggle the Lesser/Legends|Poggle the Lesser]]. After they tracked him down to the [[Progate Temple/Legends|Progate Temple]], Buzz found and removed the cover from a hole leading down to the [[Geonosian catacombs/Legends|Geonosian catacombs]]. However, he and Unduli were then attacked by [[Zombie/Legends|zombie]] Geonosians, resulting in Buzz getting [[Death/Legends|killed]]. His body was later recovered by [[Clone Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|Cody]].

==Biography==
Like most other [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]], Buzz was [[Cloning/Legends|born]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]].<ref name="db" /> He was part of the [[41st Stormtrooper Legion|41st Elite Corps]] and was under the command of Commander [[Gree (clone trooper)/Legends|Gree]] and [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]] during the [[Second Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Second Battle of Geonosis]] around [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. Buzz participated in the attack on the [[Geonosis primary droid foundry/Legends|Geonosis primary droid foundry]] to lure the [[Droid Army|droid forces]] from detecting [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] and [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]], who were secretly infiltrating the factory. After the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] passed a tower, [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] [[Warrior caste (Geonosian)/Legends|warriors]] boxed the army in and, although Buzz managed to shoot down a number of them with a [[Z-6 rotary blaster cannon/Legends|blaster cannon]], the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy's]] new [[Separatist super-tank prototype/Legends|super tanks]] began destroying their artillery and vehicles. Buzz, along with the rest of the [[41st Stormtrooper Legion|41st Elite Corps]], [[Torrent Company/Legends|Torrent Company]], and the [[212th Attack Battalion/Legends|212th Attack Battalion]], began to retreat, while Generals [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Skywalker]] and Unduli planted bombs underneath the bridge, destroying it and the super tanks. The factory was destroyed, and the following collapse of the droid facility caused the clone forces to retreat before the area became consumed in the debris cloud.
[[File:Buzz_LoT.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Buzz entering the Progate Temple]]

Once the droid factory was destroyed, General Unduli and Buzz tracked [[Poggle the Lesser/Legends|Poggle the Lesser]] on two [[BARC speeder/Legends|BARC speeders]]. Unduli contacted fellow [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]] regarding the situation. After Buzz discovered and analyzed a Geonosian munitions crate, he was able to determine the route Poggle had taken and the two traveled through a sandstorm to the [[Progate Temple/Legends|Progate Temple]]. There, Buzz found a cover leading to the underground catacombs before the two of them were attacked by [[Zombie/Legends|undead]] Geonosians which resulted in Buzz's demise. General Luminara Unduli was later saved.

==Personality and traits==
As a clone of [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] and like all other troopers Buzz stood at 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]]. He possessed a sense of dry humor. After spending enough time with [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]], Buzz developed an attitude of patience and loyalty to his commanding officer. He was also able to track an escaped Poggle the Lesser by examining a munitions container dropped by the Geonosian's guards.

==Equipment==
Buzz, like all clones at that period, utilized [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase I clone trooper armor]]. Buzz's armor had green markings and on his helmet there were small [[tally mark]]s indicating how many enemy droids he had taken out. During the march on the droid factory during the Second Battle of Geonosis, Buzz wielded a [[Z-6 rotary blaster cannon/Legends|Z-6 rotary blaster cannon]]. After the factory was destroyed, he used a standard [[DC-15S/Legends|DC-15S]]. He could also use a [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]] to a useful degree, specifically a BARC speeder.

==Behind the scenes==
In the Trivia & Details section of the [[Weapons Factory]] Episode Guide, another clone trooper present at the battle, [[Draa/Legends|Draa]], is mistakenly credited with Buzz's line "Buckle your belts and check your cells, soldiers. We're going in."

Like every [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] in ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'', Buzz was voiced by [[Dee Bradley Baker]].
